'''Lilypad Town''' (Japanese: '''スイレンタウン''' ''Suiren Town'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in the [[Sinnoh]] [[region]]. It was first mentioned in ''[[DP133|Uncrushing Defeat!]]'', in which it was shown on a map to be located just southeast of [[Lake Acuity]]. {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} decided to head there after [[Nurse Joy]] told {{an|Dawn}} that a [[Pokémon Contest]] slated to take place there was a short time away. In the original Japanese version, Lilypad Town was referred to by [[Marian]] as "the town of balmy breezes."

Ash, Dawn, {{an|Brock}}, {{an|Lyra}}, and [[Khoury]] arrived there in ''[[DP146|Dressed for Jess Success!]]''. Like many other {{cat|towns}} in Sinnoh, Lilypad Town has its own [[Contest Hall]], which makes the town a popular destination among [[Pokémon Coordinator]]s. One notable landmark of Lilypad Town is the Lilypad Colosseum, which is the place where many accomplished [[Pokémon Trainer]]s have {{pkmn|battle}}d. A large airport for {{wp|blimp}}s is also located nearby.

==Places of interest==
===Contest Hall===
{{main|Contest Hall}}
[[File:Lilypad Contest Top 8.png|thumb|left|250px|Contestants who cleared the first stage]]
A [[Pokémon Contest]] was held in the Lilypad Town Contest Hall in ''[[DP146|Dressed for Jess Success!]]''. {{an|Dawn}} entered the competition in hopes of winning her fifth [[Ribbon]], which would allow her to compete in the [[Sinnoh Grand Festival]]. [[Jessie]] also had plans to participate in the Lilypad Contest, but she got sick and convinced [[James]] to go compete in her place dressed as Jessilina.

In the [[Appeal|Performance Stage]], Dawn was the first {{pkmn|Coordinator}} to take the stage. She decided to use {{TP|Dawn|Piplup}}, commanding him to use {{m|Whirlpool}} followed by {{m|Bide}}. The Whirlpool came straight down on Piplup and joined forces with Bide, causing Piplup to glow an intense blue from the energy reaction. Their performance impressed the [[Contest Judge|panel of judges]], with [[Raoul Contesta]] commenting that it was a performance of the highest caliber. After a few other contestants, Jessilina was called on stage. With {{MTR}} as her partner, she displayed his skills creatively, commanding him to use {{m|Fury Swipes}} to slice the {{wp|ramen}} dough into three bowls, which she later served to the judges. Their performance surprised the judges and made {{OBP|Christopher|DP117}}, who was watching from [[television]], cry in delight.

[[File:Lilypad Ribbon.png|thumb|250px|The Lilypad Ribbon]]
Following [[Marian]]'s [[Contest announcer|announcement]] of the eight contestants who moved on to the [[Contest Battle]]s, Dawn was shown battling a Coordinator named [[Mario]], using her {{TP|Dawn|Mamoswine}} against his {{p|Granbull}}. Mamoswine managed to [[Fainting|knock out]] Granbull with a triple [[Contest combination|combo]]; first swallowing its own {{m|Ice Shard}} to gain icy spikes on its back, then using {{m|Hidden Power}} to make the ice shine brighter, and then moving towards its opponent while using {{m|Take Down}}. Although Dawn had advanced to the semifinals, she was unhappy with how short the battle was as she wanted to display more of Mamoswine's talents.

In the semifinals, Dawn went up against Jessilina, who was using {{TP|James|Carnivine}}. During the battle, Carnivine used {{m|Vine Whip}} to steal Mamoswine's Ice Shard, and this angered the {{pkmn|category|Twin Tusk Pokémon}} so much that it [[Obedience|stopped listening]] to Dawn's commands. It tried to attack Carnivine several times, but Carnivine dodged its attacks in a graceful manner, lowering Dawn's score in the process. When time ran out, Jessilina was shown to be ahead of Dawn by a large amount of points. She advanced to the finals, where Carnivine defeated a {{p|Tyrogue}} to earn Jessilina the prestigious Lilypad Ribbon, her third Contest Ribbon overall.

===Lilypad Colosseum===
[[File:Lilypad Colosseum Statues.png|thumb|250px|Dialga and Palkia statues]]
The Lilypad Colosseum is located on the outskirts of Lilypad Town. It was featured in ''[[DP147|Bagged Then Tagged!]]''. Upon entering the Colosseum, {{an|Brock}} mentioned it is the place where successful {{pkmn|Trainer}}s in the [[Sinnoh]] [[region]]'s ancient times worked with their {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} to strengthen both body and spirit. The Colosseum contains monuments dedicated to the [[Legendary Pokémon]] {{p|Dialga}} and {{p|Palkia}}. According to Dawn, there is a legend that says that Trainers and {{tc|Pokémon Breeder|Breeders}}' wishes come true when they touch the statues then {{pkmn|training|train Pokémon}}.

The Colosseum's battlefield was the place where Ash and Dawn had their [[Multi Battle|Tag Battle]] against {{an|Lyra}} and [[Khoury]], using {{AP|Monferno}} and {{TP|Dawn|Cyndaquil}} against {{p|Chikorita}} and {{p|Totodile}}. During the battle, Totodile [[Evolution|evolved]] into {{TP|Khoury|Croconaw}}, surprising Ash and Dawn. Despite that, Ash and Dawn's teamwork proved successful and they won the battle. Although she lost, Lyra was still happy knowing that she and Khoury performed rather well in a battle against Ash, a Trainer with seven [[Gym]] [[Badge]]s under his belt, and Dawn, a Coordinator one {{pkmn|Contest}} [[Ribbon]] away from the [[Grand Festival]].

===Lilypad Airport===
:''See also: [[Air transportation in the Pokémon world#Blimps|Air transportation in the Pokémon world → Blimps]]''
The Lilypad Airport appeared in ''[[DP147|Bagged Then Tagged!]]''. After wrapping up the [[Johto Festival]], [[Khoury's father]] went to the airport, where he called his son and asked where he could meet him. Now remembering that the flight to [[Johto]] was soon going to leave, Khoury and Lyra rushed to the airport along with Ash, Dawn, and Brock. There, Khoury thanked Brock for all his help and Brock said that Khoury should get to know more {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}, as well as more Trainers and Coordinators. Lyra then asked Khoury to go on a {{pkmn|journey}} together with her once they got to Johto and Khoury agreed. Then the five young Trainers bid their farewells and Khoury's father gave Brock a [[Pokégear]]. After that, they boarded the flight to Johto and left.
